steps.title: Install Python 3.10 to 3.12
steps.detail: The sound tools run in their own Python environment. Python 3.13 and newer are not supported yet.

steps.title: Install ffmpeg
steps.detail: Needed to export .ogg and .mp3. Run this in a terminal, then restart Unify.

steps.title: Set up the sound tools
steps.detail: Ask an agent to run sound_setup with tier "core". It builds the Python environment in the background; sound_status shows when it's done.
steps.copy: Run sound_setup with tier core, then wait for it with sound_job.

steps.title: Add AI sound generation (optional)
steps.detail: About 5 GB. Run sound_setup with tier "ai", accept the model licence on Hugging Face, then save a read token with sound_config hfToken.

steps.title: Add a Freesound key (optional)
steps.detail: Lets agents search Freesound's CC0 library. Save the key with sound_config freesoundToken.
